bounded_observations.observation: Tile onUpdate returns client-side, handles redstone stop/restart, and invokes performRitual at activeTime%currentRefreshTime==0 before increment. performRitual requires server/current/enabled, valid structure and uncanceled RitualRunEvent, repairs ranges then calls concrete ritual; invalid structure invokes stop. stop posts cancelable stop event, calls ritual stop and clears ritual/active/time for nonredstone break only. onUpdate sets active=false before calling redstone stop, so cancellation does not itself undo that assignment. Activation method, base ticker registration, event definitions, helper validation and ritual stop implementation are unexpanded: no complete natural activation/cleanup claim.

FeatheredKnife concrete method checks owner currentEssence>=20 else causeNausea and return, reads permitted will pools, sets refreshTime10 or20, and computes maxEffects=currentEssence/20. It locates/caches a relative altar or scans configured range; getEntitiesOfClass(Player) in configured box has no explicit Boss/fake/creative/alive filter in this method. Ratio gate is >0.3 normally, >0.7 with steadfast threshold, or >0.1 for nonowner with vengeful threshold. Ordinary sacrificedHealth stays1, so ratio is a precheck, not an exact final health floor. With corrosive incense mode, SOUL_FRAY veto applies and requested health equals health-maxHP*ratio.
